name: Leaver paid for unused leave at the month-before day rate (final settlement)
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: Last day 11 September 2026: 10 of the month's 26 working days were paid (paidDaysCenti 1000). The structure: base 48,000,000, responsibility allowance 4,000,000 (insurable, attendance-prorated), meal allowance 730,000 (exempt up to 730,000, attendance-prorated).

The leave ledger paid out 3.5 unused days (daysCenti 350). The law prices a day on the salary under the contract of the month before the month of leaving (August 2026) divided by that month's normal working days (26 on a Monday-to-Saturday schedule).
Seeded leave.payout_basis = base_plus_insurable_allowances: 48,000,000 + 4,000,000 (the responsibility allowance counts towards the insurance base; the meal allowance does not) = 52,000,000.
LEAVE_PAYOUT = 52,000,000 x 350 / (26 x 100) = 52,000,000 x 350 / 2600 = 7,000,000 exactly. It is taxable and outside the insurance base.
Insurance: uncovered working days = 26 - 10 = 16, at or above the seeded threshold of 14, so the month carries no compulsory insurance.
Net = 27,280,769 - 650,000 = 26,630,769. The result names the leaver (leaves_in_period) so C&B types in the rest of the settlement.
